title: T1598 — Phishing for Information
subtitle: The animation below walks through one complete phishing-for-information attempt in eight steps.
aria: Animated simulation of a phishing for information attack. An attacker crafts a lure, sends it through a delivery channel, an employee shares information, and the SOC detects and blocks the activity in eight steps.

nodes.label: Attacker
nodes.tip: The threat actor running a phishing for information campaign. They want answers, not infections.

nodes.label: Email / Social / Phone
nodes.tip: The service that carries the lure: email, a chat platform, or a phone call.

nodes.label: Employee
nodes.tip: The person the attacker wants information from. Anyone can be a target.

nodes.label: Intel Notes
nodes.tip: The attacker's growing file of facts about your organization.

nodes.label: SOC / Defender
nodes.tip: Your security team. They look for signs of the campaign and help users.

steps.title: Pick target
steps.caption: The attacker picks an employee and writes a message that asks for sensitive details. The story sounds normal: a job offer, an IT check, or a vendor question.
steps.defender: Reconnaissance happens outside your network. There is nothing in your logs yet.

fields.detail: The attacker picks an employee and writes a message that asks for sensitive details. The story sound

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Send lure
steps.caption: The lure travels through a normal channel and lands in the inbox, chat list, or phone of the target.
steps.defender: Gateway and platform logs record a new external message. Save this record.

fields.detail: The lure travels through a normal channel and lands in the inbox, chat list, or phone of the target.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Target reads
steps.caption: The employee reads the message. The request looks believable, so they keep reading.
steps.defender: No alert fires here. This blind window is what awareness training must shrink.

fields.detail: The employee reads the message. The request looks believable, so they keep reading.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Info flows out
steps.caption: The employee answers with the requested information, or fills in a fake form. No malware is needed.
steps.defender: Data loss prevention and mail-flow logs may catch sensitive data leaving.

fields.detail: The employee answers with the requested information, or fills in a fake form. No malware is needed.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Intel recorded
steps.caption: The attacker saves the new details and updates the target profile for the next stage.
steps.defender: Nothing is logged in your estate now. The information lives with the attacker.

fields.detail: The attacker saves the new details and updates the target profile for the next stage.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Follow-up ask
steps.caption: The attacker pushes for one more piece, often an MFA code, a document, or a phone number.
steps.defender: Repeated contact from the same external party is a useful signal. Correlate the thread.

fields.detail: The attacker pushes for one more piece, often an MFA code, a document, or a phone number.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Defender sees
steps.caption: A user report or a gateway rule surfaces the thread. The SOC reviews headers, links, and timing.
steps.defender: Reply-to mismatch, lookalike domains, and odd hours build the case.

fields.detail: A user report or a gateway rule surfaces the thread. The SOC reviews headers, links, and timing.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Block and hunt
steps.caption: The SOC blocks the sender, hunts for other recipients, and refreshes user training with this example.
steps.defender: Hunt across all mailboxes for the same sender, subject, and links.

fields.detail: The SOC blocks the sender, hunts for other recipients, and refreshes user training with this example

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
